title: Line Ratios Reveal N<SUB>2</SUB>H<SUP>+</SUP> Emission Originates above the Midplane in TW Hydrae
question: At what gas temperature do the N2H+ 1-0 and 4-3 lines emit in TW Hya, and does the emission trace the midplane CO snowline?

data.sensitivity: 1-0: 2.2 K per 0.1 km/s channel; 4-3: 0.71 K per 0.1 km/s channel

what.value: Disk physical and kinematic properties from CS analysis, used for deprojection

evidence.quote: assuming the physical and kinematic properties derived from previous analysis of the CS emission in TW Hya (cite: Teague18b)

what.value: CO freeze-out temperature of 21 K and 13CO temperature profile

evidence.quote: At the relevant radii in TW Hya the freeze out temperature is expected to be 21 K (cite: Schwarz16).

recipe.method: Upper limit RMS x sqrt(Nchan) x dv for 1-0 non-detection
Deproject annuli to system velocity and stack (Yen16 method)

recipe.goal: Check optical depth from hyperfine ratios
recipe.method: Hyperfine line ratios relative to 1_{2,3}-0_{1,2}; gives tau>1 (1.5 to 66), judged unreliable due to low S/N
LTE ratio of integrated intensities of 4-3 and 1-0

answer_key.quantity: Excitation temperature of N2H+ emitting gas, 0.8-2''

evidence.quote: Using these values we find an excitation temperature of 39 K, with a one sigma uncertainty of 2 K.
$5.1\pm0.2$ K km s$^{-1}$ for the 1-0 transition
$28.7\pm0.8$ K km s$^{-1}$ for the 4-3 transition
upper limit on the integrated line intensity of 2.7 K km s$^{-1}$ for a single hyperfine component

not_stated_but_needed: Disk geometry and stellar mass values used in eddy deprojection
Line-free channels and uvcontsub fit order
tclean parameters, cell and image size for 1-0 cube
Hyperfine components and frequencies used for integration
How the 4-3 data were processed beyond Qi13b
Details of how the 39 K and 2 K uncertainty were computed (hyperfine treatment, error propagation)
score_reason: Short letter with public data and a simple calculation, but stacking and imaging parameters are missing.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, simple line-ratio recipe, and numeric main result, though some settings are unstated.
